system.effect:
Pester Balls are small balls full of chemicals that come in six varieties, each of which inflicts a different Status Affliction when they hit a target. The Status Afflictions they can cause are: @UUID[Compendium.ptu.effects.Item.XWqLLq9Vb9h0eZwh]{Rage}, @UUID[Compendium.ptu.effects.Item.pLKjxFPUOZQHAcXH]{Confusion}, @UUID[Compendium.ptu.effects.Item.NA1Vn8A2h6JIIUhj]{Burn}, @UUID[Compendium.ptu.effects.Item.299X6pActAV8ITz7]{Poison}, @UUID[Compendium.ptu.effects.Item.bzZaLfYxVyKbJOCo]{Paralysis}, and @UUID[Compendium.ptu.effects.Item.RekZDOcIsADhrfH3]{Sleep}.

After being hit by any Pester Ball, a target becomes immune to the effects of further Pester Balls of the same status for the rest of the Scene. Throwing and hitting with Pester Balls is the same as with Poké Balls.
system.name: Pester Ball
